{{missing image|2=Missing ORAS model}} [[File:Trick Master anime.png|thumb|250px|The Trick Master in ''[[Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire]]'']] The '''Trick Master''' (Japanese: '''カラクリ{{tt|大王|だいおう}}''' ''King of Tricks'') is a [[Non-player character|character]] in [[Pokémon Ruby and Sapphire Versions|Ruby, Sapphire]], {{v2|Emerald}}, [[Pokémon Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire|Omega Ruby, and Alpha Sapphire]]. He lives on {{rt|110|Hoenn}} in the [[Trick House]]. ==In the games== He provides the {{player}} with eight{{sup/3|RSE}}/six{{sup/6|ORAS}} challenges, each beginning with him hiding somewhere in the front room. Once the player finds him, he gives a small speech and says that he will be hiding in the back. Once the player completes the challenge, he will reward them with a prize. After all challenges are completed, the Trick Master disappears, leaving behind only a note saying he has gone on a journey to search for new tricks. ===Quotes=== {{main|Trick Master/Quotes}} ===Sprites and models=== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; font-size: 80%; {{roundy|20px}} border: 2px solid #{{Hoenn color dark}}; background: #{{hoenn color}};" |- | style="{{roundy|80px}} border: 2px solid #{{Hoenn color dark}}; background: #{{hoenn color light}}; width:80px; height:80px"| [[File:Dock OD.png]] | style="{{roundy|80px}} border: 2px solid #{{Hoenn color dark}}; background: #{{hoenn color light}}; width:80px; height:80px"| [[File:Dock Emerald OD.png]] |- | Overworld sprite from

{{color2|000|Pokémon Emerald Version|Emerald}} |} ==In animation== ===History=== The Trick Master's only appearance in {{pkmn|animation}} was in the {{aniseries|RS}} episode ''[[AG039|A Poké-BLOCK Party!]]'', although he is referred to as the '''King of Tricks''' in the dub. Every year, he holds a contest at his {{ci|Mauville}} [[Trick House]], with the winner receiving a one-year supply of [[Pokéblock]]. The King of Tricks is a particularly eccentric character who often laughs maniacally and speaks in rhymes. ===Voice actors=== {{vatable|color={{hoenn color}}|bordercolor={{hoenn color light}} |ja=梅津秀行 ''Hideyuki Umezu'' |en=[[Ted Lewis|Ed Paul]] |ar=نبيل عساف ''Nabil Assaf'' |es_eu=Carlos Ysbert |fr_eu=Benoît Van Dorslaer |it=Daniele Demma |pt_br=Paulo Porto |pl=Ireneusz Machnicki}} ==In the manga== [[File:Trick Master Adventures.png|thumb|220px|Trick Master in [[Pokémon Adventures]]]] ===Pokémon Adventures=== ====History==== ====={{MangaArc|Ruby & Sapphire}}===== The Trick Master is a friend of [[Wattson]], and the pair were attempting to catch a trouble-making [[Phado|Donphan]] but accidentally caught [[Sapphire (Adventures)|Sapphire]] instead. Upon learning that Sapphire accidentally found the entrance to [[New Mauville]], the trio are chased around by the Donphan when Sapphire accidentally clips it with one of Wattson's Dynamo Badges. The Trick Master falls down with Sapphire and Donphan but are attacked by New Mauville's generator, a large robot that attached itself to Wattson and several Electric Pokémon. While unable to help Sapphire and Donphan directly, the Trick Master correctly deduces that the robot can only absorb electricity before releasing at certain intervals. This allows Sapphire defeat the robot when its attack is redirected by Wattson's [[Wattson's Manectric|Electrike]]. When the Trick Master and Wattosn investigate the defeated robot, however, it is revealed that it was made by the Trick Master's ancestor, and that defeating the robot allowed it to return power to New Mauville, turning the underground city into a theme park. During the crisis from {{p|Kyogre}} and {{p|Groudon}}'s the Trick Master would customize New Mauville's robot to fly before moving to join Sapphire in her attempt to reach [[Sootopolis City]], which now had a lingering barrier from the many legendary Pokémon that assembled in its radius. The Trick Master would use the robot to charge up both {{TP|Sapphire|Minun}} and {{TP|Ruby|Plusle}}, allowing them to blow a hole into Sootopolis when the pair release their supercharged blast. The Trick Master would remain on guard to block [[Archie]] and [[Maxie]]'s escape, but is knocked down from the sky by their air car. After the crisis is resolved, the Trick Master and Wattson would return back to Mauville City to continue maintaining New Mauville. It was also revealed that he likes to visit different [[region]]s, such as [[Johto]] and [[Fiore]], to improve his designs. ====={{MangaArc|Emerald}}===== While travelling in Johto, the Trick Master ended up meeting {{adv|Emerald}}, who had runaway from his abusive family members and dreamed of creating artificial limbs to compensate for his small size. By chance, the Trick Master was thrilled by Emerald's ideas, and the pair became fast friends. Upon learning that Emerald had been bullied, he ends up recommending Emerald to [[Earl Dervish]]'s [[Pokémon academy]]. When Emerald is only kept as an interim [[Pokédex holder]], he converses with the Trick Master again, who replies that whining and sulking over the issue would not solve it. Instead, the Trick Master provides Emerald with the completed tools he originally sketched from their first meeting. Additionally, the Trick Master would craft a special soil dispenser based on Emerald's ability to quickly deduce a Pokémon's birthplace. Through this contraption, Emerald could create a surrounding seal to calm a target by filling its mind with a sense of nostalgia. In ''[[PS337|Epilogue]]'', he makes a cameo appearance on a boat heading to the {{Gdis|Battle Frontier|III}}. ====={{MangaArc|Black 2 & White 2}}===== In ''[[PS548|Epilogue]]'', the Trick Master briefly appeared in the [[International Police]] office with {{adv|Green}}. ====={{MangaArc|Omega Ruby & Alpha Sapphire}}===== The Trick Master was seen watching a news report about a [[Grand Meteor Delta|giant meteoroid]] that threatens to destroy the world. Later, he was called to Sootopolis City to assist in stopping the meteoroid. ====Character==== The Trick Master (known as '''Coil''' in [[Chuang Yi]]'s translation) is a close friend of [[Wattson]] and {{adv|Emerald}} and helped them design their gadgets. ==Names== {{langtable|color={{hoenn color light}}|bordercolor={{hoenn color}} |zh_yue=戲法大師 ''{{tt|Heifaat Daaihsī|Trick Master}}'' |zh_cmn=戲法大王 ''{{tt|Xìfǎ Dàwáng|King of Tricks}}'' {{tt|*|Animated series}}
